story.heading: Why the Main Line consigns here
paragraphs: Home Furnishing Consignment sits in the Gateway Shopping Center on East Swedesford Road, where Main Line households drop off the furniture they have outgrown.
The store's own advice is the business model: shop early and often. Items arrive daily and the return policy stays reasonable.

experience.heading: Shopping and consigning
items: Walk the floor in Wayne seven days a week.
Consigning starts with a call, then a showroom spot in front of real buyers.
Appealing prices and a reasonable return policy on every purchase.

feature.heading: Consign the piece, keep the profit
feature.text: A dining table in a garage earns nothing. On the floor in Wayne it meets the Main Line buyers already looking for it.
